notes: Weather can now show an hourly forecast as well as the ten-day one, and you choose which. Sigil did not have hourly numbers at all before -- they are now fetched on the same request as everything else, so it is not a second thing that can…
The choice is saved with the layout, so a card keeps the forecast you picked.
A taller weather card no longer shows fewer days than a shorter one of the same width. How many entries a series holds is decided by the width alone; extra height is now air around the row.
